page_title: TOT 1-0 MNU | Tottenham Hotspur v Manchester Utd 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Lacking Match Fitness

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+2' Ben Davies (Tottenham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Tottenham win a corner.
90+1' Substitution. Casemiro walks off the pitch and Chidozie Obi (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
90+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' A yellow card for a tackle by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United). Peter Bankes doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

89' Casemiro (Manchester United) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
89' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
89' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd win a corner kick.
87' Heung-Min Son will be replaced by Wilson Odobert (Tottenham).
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester Utd.

84' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.

83' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
80' Manchester Utd fail to score from a corner as Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) leaps to collect the ball.

80' Manchester Utd show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.
79' Ben Davies (Tottenham) sees a yellow card from Peter Bankes after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

79' This was a piece of cake for Andre Onana. Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
79' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
78' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) replacing Rodrigo Bentancur.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Archie Gray (Tottenham) is replacing Kevin Danso.

78' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

75' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Andre Onana was alert and the score remained the same.
74' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

74' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Corner kick. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity.

73' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Guglielmo Vicario, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.

72' What an opportunity! Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
69' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
69' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.

68' Djed Spence (Tottenham) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Andre Onana!
67' The resulting corner from Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
66' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. It will be a corner kick for Tottenham.
65' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

65' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
64' Here is a change. Lucas Bergvall is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and James Maddison trots off the pitch and is replaced by Brennan Johnson (Tottenham).
62' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
62' The corner kick from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
62' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
61' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

61' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Tottenham.
58' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but the keeper dives and denies him.

57' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.

55' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
54' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
53' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
51' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
49' That's an easy save for Andre Onana, following a first time shot towards the middle of the goal from Mathys Tel (Tottenham).
49' Tottenham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Tottenham are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Good work from Tottenham as they win a corner.
47' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
46' The whistle blows and Peter Bankes starts the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' The free kick is taken by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), but ball is cleared.
44' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to Tottenham.
43' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
41' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Casemiro (Manchester United) for his blatant foul.
39' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
38' Peter Bankes has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ben Davies (Tottenham). Manchester Utd have a free kick.

35' James Maddison (Tottenham) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Manchester Utd win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
34' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
33' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
31' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
30' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
27' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

27' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Andre Onana anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Tottenham force their opponents to concede a corner.
25' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.

24' What a big chance! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.

22' What a great effort! Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
20' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
19' That's unlucky! Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
17' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
16' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! James Maddison (Tottenham) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:0.
13' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
12' The resulting set piece from Manchester Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

11' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Guglielmo Vicario sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

10' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
9' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
6' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
5' Djed Spence (Tottenham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
5' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) is penalised for holding. Peter Bankes signals a set piece. It's a free kick to Tottenham in a dangerous position.
4' Flag up against Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
3' Tottenham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Peter Bankes.
